goal: Create one short, deterministic title-card candidate through the standalone Video Studio domain adapters, then bind full technical QA to the exact rendered bytes.
audience: Technology viewers; the operational audience is a Video Studio worker using only declared local inputs and the standalone runtime.

craft_contract.visual: Legible typography with measured glyph layout.
craft_contract.audio: Silent visual candidate; sound is a separate task.

hard_constraints: The local renderer produces a candidate only.
The exact EditorialPlan must authorize the ShotContract.
The final candidate must pass canonical FFmpeg/FFprobe technical QA.
Font and rights evidence must be imported as declared assets.
preferences: Prefer local deterministic rendering for information graphics.
Keep the task graph minimal and parallelize only independent authoring tasks.
unknowns: The owner must supply/import a font file with usage rights evidence.
success_criteria: ShotContract is derived from the exact EditorialPlan.
A non-empty MP4 candidate and renderer receipt are registered.
Canonical technical QA passes against the candidate's exact artifact ID and SHA-256.
